description: Measure BPM and musical key (with Camelot code) from the audio of a SoundCloud track, using a 30-second window starting at `position` ms. BPM is corrected for half/double-time errors using the track's genre. First call takes ~5–15 s; repeat calls are cached for 30 days. Limited to 6 calls per minute per client. Preview snippets (≤60 s) are rejected.

position.description: Start of the analysis window in ms; use it for long mixes

name: analyze_track
title: Measure BPM and key
